text:
⚠️ Decline in Experience (Post-1AM):

Barricades & Forced Ejections: Multiple reviews now confirm that after 1 AM, the staff begins to clear out customers, even though it still claims to be open 24 hours. People are often ushered out or denied indoor access, especially if they’re not actively ordering food.

Hostile Staff Behavior: Late-night employees are reportedly hostile, with some customers saying they were rushed, yelled at, or refused service after certain hours without explanation.

Change in Atmosphere: It used to be bustling 24/7, but now it's often quiet, restricted, and less inviting, especially in the overnight hours.

🚫 Features That Are Gone:

Aquarium: Removed.

Custom Pizza & Pasta Stations: Removed or closed early.

Arcade Area: Still present in some form, but Disney and themed features feel limited or outdated.

Charging Stations: No longer accessible or removed entirely.

Elevator Restrictions: “Drinks Only Available First Level” shows how access is now limited, possibly to discourage loitering or overnight lounging.

📉 Why It Matters:

This location was once a flagship of 24/7 customer experience, drawing in tourists and locals alike for the novelty and size.

Now, it feels more like a standard McDonald’s with security measures, and less of a family attraction or late-night hub.

Real Review Themes (Summarized):

⭐ "Used to be fun—now it’s sterile and overly controlled."

⚠️ "Kicked out at 1:30 AM even though it's 24/7."

🚫 "Arcade is tiny, no more aquarium."

😠 "Staff were extremely rude and unwelcoming after midnight."

❌ "Don’t go late expecting the full experience—it’s a ghost of what it was."
author: Keefer Hershewe

text:
EN

You have to ask several times to be served, and in the end they deliver the wrong order late.
We waited 1h30 hours and no one gave us any satisfaction, only to find out that our order hadn't even been started because they didn't have any more sauce and no one to communicate this, even though we asked several times.
Shameful!

PT

Você precisa pedir varias vezes para ser atendido, no fim entregam o pedido errado e atrasado.
Aguardamos 1h30 cobrando inumeras vezes e ninguem dava satisfação, para no fim descobrirmos que nosso pedido não tinha nem sido iniciado pois não tinham mais molho e ninguém para comunicar isso, mesmo cobrando varias vezes.

ES

Tienes que pedir varias veces que te sirvan, al final entregan el pedido mal y tarde.
Esperamos 1h30 cobrando numerosas veces y nadie daba satisfacción, para descubrir que nuestra petición ni siquiera se había iniciado porque no tenían más salsa ni nadie que lo comunicara, aún cobrando varias veces.
¡Qué vergüenza!
author: Luccas

text: Que triste minha experiência, no maior McDonald's do mundo (EUA), chegando no local,fui  realizar  meu pedido no totem ,com dificuldade para entender o sistema(pois aqui é diferente no Br) ,ao fazer seu pedido, finalizando vc tem que pegar  uma placa com a numeração e coloca o num. no totem e finalizar o pedido,e esperei por quase 1H , isso porque fui reclamar que estava já algum tempo esperando,e eles pediram para aguardar,e vc só vendo *pegue retire* saindo na frente a toda hora ,passando na frente de seu pedido e de algumas pessoa que estava também aguardando o pedido para comer no restaurante, ao olhar o que estava acontecendo na frente do balcão de retirada uns colaboradores perdidos e outros colaboradores desmotivados e estressados, não sei o que aconteceu,mas deu tudo errado.poderia ser realmente como mostra ,o "super McDonald's lindo de tudo "mas na realidade é muito diferente .
author: Matumoto L.

text: I went to restaurant number 3896. We placed our order then after 20 minutes we received our pizza. After 30 minutes I asked about the rest of the order and was told to be patient since they were short staffed. After 40 minutes we asked a different employee who found our order sitting on the back counter. Half way through eating my 12 year old found a bug in her fries. I took it up to the cashier who said something in Spanish to the manager behind the counter and she responded by offering a new fry - no apology given by anyone. I was angry since they showed no real concern and my daughter is terrified of bugs. I expressed this concern but the worker response was no one is perfect. I was expecting an apology and a refund - we threw away the rest of our food and left. This vacation has been stressful enough without the added problems from McDonalds
author: tronous

text:
Fire the Saturday Manager!
Half the employees not even following state and goverment health protocols near food.
No covering hair, with some not wearing gloves when they should. To me seems like they state health inspector looks the opposite way.
Thirty minutes waiting on food, with mine coming out before someone waiting much longer then mine. I actually got more food then what I ordered and mostly wrong.
When someone said the order was wrong, they treated like the customer was just a pain in the butt.
4-5 employees just standing around in front of customers flat out ignoring them when someone tries to get their attention. Only until you stand in their way so they cant walk away, people got employees respect to talk to the customer, only then.
author: kenneth t

text: We got meals for our family of 4. Our food came fast but everything was ice cold! The staff were rude. They’re in the services industry but got an attitude for asking for help. I asked for help at the front desk she called the manager she was very rude. She was already yelling at the staff in the back like a drill Sargent before she walked over. (Nobody needs to be yelled at like that at work) She rolled her eyes at my question about the game area upstairs and told me go talk to someone up there. I get upstairs the attendant up there was just as spiteful. She looked angry just for kids trying to cash in their tickets.. that’s literally the job… the arcade is a scam. Mainly claw machines and broken games it’s hard to get any credits to cash in.
author: Karni Hayes

text:
1.10 am
Absolutely horrendous. Ordered from uber eats. Happy meal not in order. Had to go down as tried to phone got there and explained happy meal not in order. Girl looked at it and guy too thought she waa going to sort it 10 mins later still waiting said to one of the other staff is this being sorted. He said to another girl who eventually put through the  happy meal. Got a hold of the useless girl and told her that she basically blanked me and i didnt appreciate it her response was its an uber order. Shoudnt matter how it was ordered its from their  restuarant and they did it wrong. She checked her phone and couldnt find it. No apology from any one of the staff for their mistake. Disgusting service.
author: Mairi

text: Do not order DoorDash or Uber eats from this place. There is absolutely no quality check and they can care less about what you pay for. I spent $26 on dinner last night and I didn’t get my five dollar double cheeseburger, my chicken nuggets were like a month old, I didn’t get my apple pie, and the cheeseburger in the happy meal they couldn’t even get the order right. McDonald’s if you’re planning to charge these outrageous prices just for one burger the least that you can do is do a quality check before you send food with no sauce no napkins and missing items. I live in the area and will never come here again. They can rip someone else off.
author: Gio Gioo

text:
Nunca vi um Mc Donald's tão mal organizado,  para fazer o pedido é mal organizado,  para pagar e para entregar o pedido, nao tem painel, a atendente fica gritando os números, ambiente sujo, atendentes na cozinha com cabelo solto, no Google diz ser o maior Mc do mundo, ja fui em outros muito maiores.

I have never seen a McDonald's so poorly organized, to place the order is poorly organized, to pay and to deliver the order, there is no sign, the attendant keeps shouting the numbers, dirty environment, attendants in the kitchen with loose hair, on Google it says it is the biggest McDonald's in the world, I have been to others much bigger.
author: Tati Santana

text:
This is one of the busiest locations, the make millions, yet this location does not honor any of the deals advertised. Even in store at the location on the kiosk it has deals that are offered, yet you cannot add them, or use them. The employees are very rude. Over all a zero star experience even for fast food.

Update: the "store owner" has replied and reached out via a very generic response and has requested to speak about the incident further, however it is just a link to a website and no actual human has responded.
author: Danielle Taylor

text: This may be the “World’s Largest McDonald’s “, but it was the world’s largest disappointment. I was so excited to take my kids to this McDonald’s, but when we got there, barely anyone was helpful or even looked like they wanted to be there. I ordered a Bic Mac meal and a pizza, and I’m sorry but a small pizza should not take nearly 30 minutes to cook. Not to mention, a messy Big Mac was given to me along with very cold fries. Never going back there and I would advise tourists to not waste your money here.
author: Elizabeth Nunnery

text: Péssimo atendimento fiz o pedido , após alguns minutos ninguém veio trazer a mesa meu lanche ,e nisso se passou uma hora e nada reclamei com os atendentes ae me trouxeram o pedido que estava para ser retirado no balcão mas eu fiz o pedido para ser entregue na mesa ,não me pediram desculpas atendentes mal educado nao volto nunca mais , o único que atende bem e o senhor da limpeza que se preocupou comigo .

text: We ordered a pizza, pasta, a Big Mac meal and a cheese burger meal. The Big Mac arrived first, cold. 25 minutes later the pizza and pasta arrived with the most depressed server ever. No cheese burger meal although the chips arrived with my Big Mac. This place is probably ok if you are the only person but don’t go there is you can’t stand screaming kids, cold food and poor service.
author: Ashley Young

text: Worst McDonald ever and I’m concerned about my health. Fist of all I’ve never waited this long for McDonald’s anywhere even in NY LA etc. women working at 2:30 AM made us wait for 20 minute and spit and laughed on my ice cream. So disgusting. This McDonald’s is the worse for germs and unethical employees who spread germs. They have no ethical morals. Ewwwww
author: Janet Lee

text: The customer service here is the worst I have ever experienced in my life. The man at the counter and the woman handing out orders were both extremely rude and disrespectful. They treated people badly and even threw the food instead of serving it properly. I will never bring my family here again, and I would not recommend anyone to come to this place.

text: Brought my kids here.  Not only is it so expensive to play the games,  you only get "tickets" to claim.  If u don't use exact number of tickets for the prize,  you lose the rest.  I offered to pay for the exchange and was told you can only redeem the tickets.  So now I lost out there!!!  NO ONE wants to just throw away their money!!!

text: Welp. Hectic atmosphere as expexted. Messed up a $112 order (they did fix it but it made it take even longer). And the food was below average for a mcdonalds. Also they bleached the playplace, which is good, but it destroyed my sons brand new jurassic park shirt- he was not happy to say the least.
